commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Level 0: - Renamed chatbot to Kaya - Introduced the greet() function with exit()
Complete Level-1: - Added echo command and bye function
Complete Level-2: Added an list and add function
Complete Level-3 & A-Classes: - Added mark and unmark commands - Tasks are represented with a dedicated Task class
Complete Level-4 and A-Inheritance task types
commitResults.messageBody: Add Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses and parse their respective commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Level-5 and A-Exceptions error handling
commitResults.messageBody: Add KayaException and handle invalid commands, malformed task details, invalid task numbers, and task capacity errors.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Level-6 and A-Collections task deletion
commitResults.messageBody: Add the delete command and replace the fixed task array with an ArrayList-backed List.
Add CommandType and use enum-based command dispatch instead of repeated string comparisons.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add persistent storage for tasks Save task-list changes automatically and restore saved tasks on startup. Handle missing storage files, directories, and malformed records safely.

commitResults.messageBody: Parse task dates using LocalDate, display it in a readable format and safely handle legacy stored dates
Separate user interaction, command parsing, task-list management, storage, and application coordination into focused classes.
Group commands, parsing, storage, tasks, UI, and exceptions by responsibility while keeping src/main/java as the source root.
Set kaya.Kaya as the application entry point and name the executable shadow JAR kaya.jar.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for parser and storage
commitResults.messageBody: Test valid and invalid command parsing, task-index validation, persistence round trips, missing files, corrupted records, and empty task lists.
Explain how to build kaya.jar with Gradle and run it as a standalone application using Java 25.
Document all non-private application classes, methods, constructors, enum constants, and non-trivial private helpers.

Some switch cases and continuation lines do not follow the required indentation style.

Indent nested switch content consistently and remove uneven spacing so the code follows the SE-EDU Java coding standard.

Users cannot locate related tasks without reading the full task list.

Add a case-insensitive find command that searches task descriptions and displays matching tasks in their original order. Include parser and task-list tests for successful and invalid searches.
Configure Gradle to check the project against the SE-EDU Java coding standard and fix the detected violations.
Connect an FXML-based chat window to Kaya's existing command logic and support closing the application with the bye command.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use varargs for grouped UI messages
commitResults.messageBody: Add a reusable varargs helper for displaying any number of related console messages.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add assertions for task list and storage assumptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Task list operations assume non-null tasks and validated indices.
Storage assumes that tasks other than Deadline and Event are Todo tasks.

Document these assumptions with Java assertions so programming errors
are detected when assertions are enabled. Keep existing error handling
for invalid user input.

Command processing mixes dispatch with task updates and response
formatting, making individual operations harder to follow.

Extract mark, unmark, delete, and find operations into named helpers.
Rename tasksChanged to isTasksChanged to follow the boolean naming
convention requested in review.

Add regression tests covering command replies, saved changes, and
invalid arguments to verify that existing behavior is preserved.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use a stream to filter matching tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Task searching manually builds a list of matches in a loop.

Replace the loop with a stream filter and collect matches into an
ArrayList. Preserve case-insensitive matching, original task order,
and the mutable result list.
Add assertions for internal assumptions
Improve command-handling readability
Use streams for task searching

commitResults.messageTitle: Add commands to update existing task details
commitResults.messageBody:
Users currently need to delete and recreate tasks to change their
details.

Add single-field updates for descriptions, deadline dates, and event
start and end dates. Validate replacements before changing the list,
preserving task type, position, completion status, and other fields.

Document the syntax and add regression tests for valid updates,
invalid arguments, and persistence.
Add commands to update existing task details

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve Kaya's chat layout and visual styling
commitResults.messageBody:
Fixed-width message bubbles and large speaker badges limit the space available for task replies.

Introduce responsive message widths, distinct user and Kaya styling, compact speaker labels, and a cream and green theme. Add command hints, disable Send for blank input, and restore input focus after sending.
Improve Kaya's chat layout and visual styling

commitResults.messageTitle: Give Kaya a kopitiam companion personality
commitResults.messageBody:
Kaya's generic replies do not reflect its name or visual theme. Introduce a warm kopitiam voice while preserving clear task details and error guidance.

Share greetings and list messages between interfaces, distinguish empty lists from searches with no matches, and update the GUI subtitle, tests, and user-guide examples.
Give Kaya a kopitiam companion personality

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve command validation and storage error handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Ambiguous date fields can be accepted, failed saves leave changes in memory, and incomplete startup loads risk overwriting existing data.

Validate date-field order and repetition while accepting extra whitespace. Restore task snapshots after failed saves, replace saved data atomically, and block changes after incomplete loads. Add visible recovery guidance, regression tests, and documentation.
Improve command validation and storage error handling

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand automated tests and add coverage reporting
commitResults.messageBody:
Existing tests leave console sessions, boundary cases, and data isolation insufficiently covered.

Add regression tests for parsing, commands, task snapshots, storage recovery, Unicode, locales, and console sessions. Generate JaCoCo coverage reports and document automated and manual testing.
Expand automated tests and add coverage reporting

commitResults.messageTitle: Update Kaya setup instructions and acknowledge reused code
commitResults.messageBody: Replace outdated template text and source paths with Kaya's current GUI and console launch instructions. Credit the se-edu starter and JavaFX tutorial, identify adapted components, and link the user and testing guides.
Update Kaya setup instructions and acknowledge reused code

commitResults.messageTitle: Document Kaya commands and add product screenshot
commitResults.messageBody:
Users need complete command instructions and a representative view of Kaya before using the application.

Replace guide placeholders with setup steps, command examples, task numbering rules, and troubleshooting. Add the full-window screenshot as docs/Ui.png for the product website.
Document Kaya commands and add product screenshot
